notes: New: Google Maps as a map provider (road, dark, satellite, satellite + roads, terrain). Its road map shows businesses, gas stations and doctors like the Google Maps app
Your Google key stays on the map server, like the Azure key. Add it in Settings → Map
Needs one step in Google Cloud: turn on the Map Tiles API for your key (see the README)
If Google refuses, the server waits a minute before asking again, and its log says what to check
New check for Google Maps problems: python3 /opt/dji-flightmap/app/server.py --check-google (see the README)
The map's credit line now stays visible above the flight and planner panels
